# Turkish Airlines Careers

> Turkish Airlines' official careers portal offering pilot training programs, cabin crew positions, graduate opportunities, and international roles across the airline industry.

The careers portal serves as the primary recruitment hub for Turkish Airlines (Türk Hava Yolları), featuring flagship programs like Take-Off Cadet for pilot training, Take-Off Jr. for graduates, and various specialized career tracks. The site operates in multiple languages and partners with İŞKUR for internship recruitment.

## Key Topics

- Turkish Airlines (Türk Hava Yolları)
- Take-Off Cadet Program
- Pilot Training & Recruitment
- Cabin Crew Positions
- Graduate Programs (Take-Off Jr., Take-Off 101)
- Cockpit Crew
- International Positions
- Apprenticeship Programs
- Recruitment Process
- Career Opportunities
- Experienced Staff Positions
- Entry-Level Positions
- Internship Programs
- Job Application Portal
- İŞKUR Partnership

## Job Openings & Applications

- [Open Positions](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/acik-pozisyonlar): All open job positions at Turkish Airlines with online application
- [Take-Off Cadet (II. Pilot Candidate Training)](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/acik-pozisyonlar/take-off-cadet-yetistirilmek-uzere-ii-pilot-aday-adayi/8d39c5cd-35f7-418e-ac36-6bdd42ac1a1f): Take-Off Cadet pilot training program job opening and requirements
- [Take-Off Programme d'Apprentissage 2026 – France (Legal Department)](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/acik-pozisyonlar/take-off-programme-dapprentissage-2026-france-dpartement-juridique/8c53c2bd-20eb-4c2b-a59a-fd179c088b10): Apprenticeship program in legal department at Paris office, France

## Career Paths & Programs

- [Cockpit Crew & Pilot Careers](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/kokpit-ekibi): Cockpit crew and pilot career opportunities via Take-Off Cadet Program
- [Cabin Crew Careers](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/kabin-ekibi): Cabin crew career path and job description at Turkish Airlines
- [Graduate & Entry-Level Positions](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/tecrubesiz-birim-calisani-yeni-mezunogrenci): Graduate and entry-level positions via Take-Off Jr. and Take-Off 101
- [Experienced Staff Positions](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/tecrubeli-birim-calisani): Experienced staff positions and recruitment criteria at Turkish Airlines
- [International Positions](https://careers.turkishairlines.com/uluslararasi-calisan): International positions and overseas career opportunities at Turkish Airlines
